title: Live window guidance
prerequisites: A visible application window selected or opened for the learner's goal
common_mistakes: The application may still be loading
Do not infer success from a click
risk_boundaries: Choose each step from the current image and the learner's goal; there is no preset walkthrough
All clicks and typing remain with the learner
Passwords, secrets, billing, resource creation, publishing and deployment are manual
Report completion only with visible evidence matching the learner's goal
